subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are writing to confirm your recent flight booking from New York to Los Angeles. Your flight is scheduled for Friday, May 21st at 9:00 AM. Please make sure to arrive at the airport at least two hours before departure. If you have any questions or need to make changes to your booking, feel free to contact our customer service team. We wish you a pleasant journey! Best regards, The Travel Agency Team
